title: SmartView
description: A modular HUD mod — freely place, resize and toggle individual info displays. Open the built-in editor with Right Shift.
body:
# SmartView

**SmartView** is a fully modular, client-side HUD customization mod for Minecraft 1.21.11. Every element is independently toggleable, freely positionable, and resizable — show only the information you actually want, exactly where you want it.

---

## HUD Editor
Open the editor at any time with **Right Shift**. From there you can:
- **Drag** modules freely across the screen
- **Drag a corner handle** to resize any module (0.25× – 4×)
- **Shift + Scroll** over a module to adjust its background opacity
- **Reset** any module to its default position, scale and opacity
- **Search and sort** the module list
- **Collapse the panel** to freely access the right side of the screen

## Keybindings
Every module has its own optional keybind — configure it in **Controls → SmartView** or directly inside the HUD editor. Changes sync between both.

---

## Notes
- All modules are **disabled by default** — enable only what you need
- Safe for public servers: only uses information the vanilla client already receives
- Fully compatible with **Sodium**
